# RBN EXIM

> RBN EXIM is an Indian agricultural export enterprise specializing in premium, 100% natural, chemical-free coconut commodities and derivatives sourced directly from Tiptur, Karnataka—the globally renowned capital of the copra industry.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity:** RBN EXIM
- **Brand Identity:** Kalpavriksha by RBN EXIM
- **Founding Leadership:** Founded by B Manjula
- **Headquarters & Processing Hub:** K.R Extension, Ward No.19, Tiptur, Tumkur District, Karnataka 572201, India
- **Website:** https://rbnexim.com
- **Official Contact Email:** info@rbnexim.com
- **Direct Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 70190 81066
- **Business Model:** B2B Bulk Commodity Exporting & Global Supply Chain

## Core Product Offerings & Specifications

### 1. Virgin Coconut Oil (VCO)
- **Dedicated Page:** https://rbnexim.com/product-virgin-coconut-oil.html
- **HS Code:** 15131100
- **Extraction Method:** Cold-pressed directly from fresh coconut milk without chemical refining or heat.
- **Purity Profile:** Free Fatty Acid (FFA) < 0.1%, moisture < 0.1%, water-clear liquid, >50% natural lauric acid (C12).
- **Packaging:** 200L food-grade HDPE/MS drums, 1000L IBC totes, and 20ft flexibags (~21 MT).

### 2. Expeller Coconut Oil (Cooking & Industrial)
- **Dedicated Page:** https://rbnexim.com/product-coconut-oil.html
- **HS Code:** 15131900
- **Extraction Method:** Expeller pressed from sun-dried edible copra half cups from Tiptur.
- **Purity Profile:** Free Fatty Acid (FFA) < 1.0%, moisture < 0.25%, golden aroma.
- **Packaging:** 200L steel drums, 1000L IBC totes, and flexibags.

### 3. Premium Tiptur Copra (Edible & Milling Half Cups)
- **Dedicated Page:** https://rbnexim.com/product-copra.html
- **HS Code:** 12030000
- **Sourcing:** Sourced directly from APMC Tiptur, Karnataka.
- **Quality Profile:** 100% sulfur-free, high oil yield (>68%), moisture < 6%.
- **Packaging:** 25kg, 40kg, and 50kg export PP woven bags.

### 4. Coconut Shell Charcoal Powder
- **Dedicated Page:** https://rbnexim.com/product-charcoal-powder.html
- **HS Code:** 44029010
- **Mesh Size:** 200–300 mesh pulverized powder.
- **Quality Profile:** Fixed carbon >78%, ash <3%, moisture <7%.
- **Packaging:** 25kg multi-wall Kraft paper sacks with moisture liner.

### 5. Coconut Shell Charcoal Granulated Chips
- **Dedicated Page:** https://rbnexim.com/product-charcoal-chips.html
- **HS Code:** 44029010
- **Granulation:** 3x8 mesh, 4x8 mesh granulated shell chips.
- **Quality Profile:** High hardness (>98%), low volatile matter, ideal for activated carbon kilns.
- **Packaging:** 50kg woven PP bags, 1 MT jumbo bags.

### 6. Coconut Expeller Cake (Copra Meal Feed)
- **Dedicated Page:** https://rbnexim.com/product-coconut-cake.html
- **HS Code:** 23065010
- **Nutritional Profile:** Crude protein 18–22%, residual oil 7–10%, moisture <8.0%, Aflatoxin B1 <20 ppb.
- **Applications:** High bypass-energy animal feed for dairy cattle (butterfat boost), swine, and aquafeed.
- **Packaging:** 50kg laminated PP sacks, 1000kg jumbo bags.

### 7. Pure Refined & Cold-Pressed Castor Oil
- **Dedicated Page:** https://rbnexim.com/product-castor-oil.html
- **HS Code:** 15153090 / 15153020
- **Quality Profile:** Ricinoleic acid >85%, FFA <0.5% (FSG), hydroxyl value 160–168 mg KOH/g.
- **Applications:** Pharmaceutical vehicles, cosmetics, bio-lubricants, polyurethanes, and chemical resins.
- **Packaging:** 200L (225kg) steel drums, 1000L IBC totes, 20ft flexitanks.

## Quality Assurance & Compliance
- **Custom Consignment COAs:** Every export consignment is custom-tested and accompanied by an official batch Certificate of Analysis (COA) specifying exact FFA, peroxide, and moisture values.
- **Pre-Shipment Inspections:** Independent third-party inspection (SGS / Bureau Veritas) available on buyer request.
- **Chemical-Free Commitment:** Zero bleaching, zero artificial deodorization, zero sulfur burning.

## Export & Shipping Capabilities
- **Incoterms Supported:** FOB (Free on Board), CFR (Cost and Freight), and CIF (Cost, Insurance, and Freight).
- **Primary Ports of Loading:** Mangalore Port, Chennai Port, and Nhava Sheva (JNPT) Mumbai.
- **Target Export Markets:** Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia), Southeast Asia (Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia), North America (USA, Canada), and Europe.
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ):** Standard 1x20ft FCL container loads; sample test quantities available for verified enterprise buyers.
